guidance.heading: Updated Full-Year 2026 Financial Guidance
section: The Company updated its revenue, adjusted EBITDA, and adjusted free cash flow financial guidance as follows:
•Revenue: Increased most recent guidance to a range of $17.425 billion to $17.475 billion
•Adjusted EBITDA: Increased most recent guidance to a range of $5.550 billion to $5.575 billion
•Adjusted Free Cash Flow: Increased most recent guidance to a range of $2.565 billion to $2.585 billion
Board Authorized $5 Billion for Share Repurchases

On October 28, 2026, the Board of Directors approved a $5 billion share repurchase authorization effective January 1, 2027, and extending through December 31, 2029. As of September 30, 2026, the remaining purchase capacity under the prior repurchase authorization was $0.8 billion, which continues through December 31, 2026.
